skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the ideas and research content of Institutional Economics.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Characteristics and Components of Institutional Environment
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students understand the characteristics and components of the institutional environment.
Students can present various theories of institutions.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Transaction Costs, Property Rights, Social Capital, Corruption
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can explain concepts related to transaction costs, property rights, social capital, and corruption.
Students can summarize institutional theories and their relevance to developing countries.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Integrating Transaction Costs and Property Rights into Business Context
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can integrate transaction costs and property rights into the business context.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Analyzing Transaction Costs and Social Capital
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can conduct detailed analysis on transaction costs and social capital.

skill_outcomes.skill_name: Applying Institutional Research in Vietnam and Other Developing Countries
skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Students can apply institutional research in the context of Vietnam and other developing countries.
Students develop self-learning habits and select reliable data sources for research.
Students demonstrate ethical responsibility and professional conduct in presentations and research.
